normative_claims.text: This round is a governed FAR research round whose executable actions are the low-friction, agent-authorised subset of its own ruling; owner-gated items are prepared, never attempted.
Remote publication is evidence-only: no product code, no policy, no workflow and no hook is modified in the target repository, and no existing merged evidence is rewritten.
Writer and checker run on different model axes; the checker arm is pinned by --require-arm because the verification pool's rank-1 arm is the writer's own model.
The acceptance report's P0 findings are closed only by their own 1:1 oracle; an archive merge, a file's existence or a green aggregate is not that oracle.
Every count in the evidence pack is derived from artifacts on disk by a script and is re-derivable by an independent lane.

intent.goal: Under the Fabric governance contract with HG-KSEOS as the sole control plane and canonical Hermes as its governed Runtime/Orchestration Plane, run the FAR method (run id FAR-20261016-018) over every residual, gap, blocked item, owner-decision item, unlanded candidate asset and session closeout/handover obligation left by the R7-R11 evidence-archive round; state one ranked engineering ruling whose executable actions are low-friction, high-feasibility, high-necessity, not over-engineered and aligned with the upper blueprint and the acceptance report; then execute that ruling, because the owner has pre-authorised its execution, and publish the evidence.
intent.user_expected_outcome: A ranked ruling with a machine-readable residual register; the agent-executable actions actually executed with raw receipts (a measured checker-isolation probe, the reconstructed skill entry map, a reproducible lane-defect dossier, a session handover checkpoint); the owner-gated items prepared in one-action form; and a published, readback-bound evidence pack for external acceptance.
intent.user_expected_experience: The operator supplies only the goal, the source roots and the credential path; the system reads the sources itself, resolves the branches, reuses the existing HG-KSEOS lanes, admits the work through the shared spine, preflights, repairs minimally only where required, publishes through the credential broker, and reports per-PR URL, final SHA and archival decision. Only real power nodes stop for human decision.
explicit_constraints: HG-KSEOS remains the sole control plane; no second scheduler, reducer, DB, board or evidence authority is created.
Remote publication is evidence-only under a single new EVIDENCE/ prefix; no existing evidence is rewritten.
The maker never self-accepts; the checker lane is pinned cross-model and may not write to the subject.
Owner-gated items (merge, release, cross-repo code promotion, canonical control-plane edits, product-host ACL) are prepared, not attempted.
Every probe must be able to fail, and must be shown failing, before it is shown passing.
Counts live inside artifacts; a number that exists only in chat is unverifiable.
The registry is read, never edited, to make a measurement come out right.
Credential values are read only by a local broker process and never printed or committed.
non_goals: Full 221-case / G-A-H convergence, production promotion, or any RUNTIME_READY claim.
Promoting the R7-02 validator code into the PIPD repository, or merging the peer chain #6/#8/#10.
Promoting PR #12 out of draft, or editing any merged R6-R11 evidence.
Re-slimming the two already-slimmed skills, or treating the reference-count soft warning as a hard gate.
Building a new governance plane, virtualization layer or verifier system to close the isolation finding.
authorized_mutations: Create one new EVIDENCE/ prefix in shw097-team/Fabric holding this round's evidence pack (additive commits on a new branch).
Create the round's own probe scripts, receipts and registers under the round's handover directory.
Reconstruct the missing entry_map.json index for the HGK skill from the skill's own verified SKCV pointer lines (local asset, additive; no existing byte altered).
Create the session handover/closure artifacts and the FAR run's own METHOD/DECISION_QUESTION/EXECUTION_RECORD documents.
forbidden_mutations: Editing config/lane-routing-registry.yaml, config/lane-route-slots.candidate.json or any canonical control-plane file.
Editing, deleting or force-updating any branch or evidence already merged into main.
Merging any pull request, promoting any draft, tagging or releasing.
Executing any archived .py/.ps1 helper from an evidence tree.
Printing, committing or transmitting the credential value.
allowed_hitl: Owner-scoped merge of the peer chain #6/#8/#10.
Owner-scoped promotion or merge of PR #12.
Cross-repo validator code promotion (R7-02) and the Fresh G1 owner certificate (R7-04).
Any canonical control-plane or product-host ACL change.
Any expansion of this round's change class beyond EVIDENCE_ONLY.

must_not_reopen: canonical lane registry and route slots
